title: Probability Foundations for ML
description: The probability vocabulary every ML explanation assumes you already have.
learningOutcomes: Reason correctly about independent and conditional events
Explain Bayes' theorem and use it on a real example
Explain common distributions used throughout ML

lessons.title: Events, Independence, and Conditional Probability
lessons.description: The vocabulary every later lesson assumes you have.

lessons.title: Bayes' Theorem
lessons.description: Updating a belief when new evidence arrives — the basis of a lot of ML reasoning.
learningObjectives: Solve a classic Bayes' theorem problem correctly
Connect Bayes' theorem to a classifier's predicted probability

lessons.title: Random Variables and Expectation
lessons.description: Turning outcomes into numbers, and summarizing them with expectation.
learningObjectives: Compute expected value for a simple distribution
Explain variance as spread around the expectation

lessons.title: Distributions You Will Actually See
lessons.description: Normal, Bernoulli, and uniform distributions, and where each shows up in ML.
learningObjectives: Recognize a normal distribution and its parameters
Recognize a Bernoulli distribution behind binary classification
Explain why the normal distribution shows up so often
